review_candidates.title: Project Controls Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description This Opportunity WSP is seeking a Project Controls Manager to join their Project Controls team supporting Power & Energy programs, including transmission and substation capital projects. This individual can sit in our WSP locations in either South Jordan, UT or Las Vegas, NV. Your Impact Provide oversight of finance, schedule, and document controls across transmission, substation, and related power delivery programs, leading a multidisciplinary team of cost analysts, schedulers, risk managers, and document control specialists. Create and maintain program/project schedules; review, monitor, and control contractor and consultant schedules, identifying cost and scheduling issues and recommending resolutions to the Program Manager. Develop and implement project controls processes, including change management, cost/schedule standardization, and reporting across enterprise initiatives. Prepare cost estimates, budgets, forecasts, cash flows, financial models, and other financial projections; oversee project accounting and earned value management (EVM) practices. Develop advanced Power BI dashboards and analytics tools to provide leadership and clients with actionable insights for decision-making. Administer a Cost Management System (e.g., e-Builder, Procore, or similar PMIS); track acquisition packages for reimbursement and oversee invoice review and processing. Provide oversight of vendor selection, contractor progress, change orders, punch list completion, and project close-out; collaborate in contract review and negotiation for regulatory compliance. Coordinate with client Finance & Budget, Treasury, and Internal Audit functions, and support renewable energy/utility compliance efforts (RFPs, proposal evaluation, regulatory filings). Supervise and develop project controls staff, improving reporting accuracy and system utilization across Oracle, Primavera P6, Procore, and related platforms. Who You Are Minimum Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Construction Management, or equivalent; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 12+ years of experience in financial controls, finance/accounting, and scheduling on large-scale capital projects, including experience leading a team of professionals. Power & Energy industry experience preferred, particularly transmission and substation construction programs. Project management experience required; PMP or equivalent certification preferred. Extensive knowledge of earned value management (EVM), cost forecasting, and schedule management best practices. Reporting & BI Tools: Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Power BI, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; Adobe Design and Publisher a plus. PMIS/Scheduling: Experience with PMIS platforms such as e-Builder, Oracle EBS, Maximo, PowerPlant, Primavera P6, Procore, or Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Microsoft Project or similar scheduling software. Leadership: Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams, including cost analysts, schedulers, risk managers, and document control specialists. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across teams, contractors, and clients, and present clearly to executive stakeholders. WSP Benefits: WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper. www.wsp.com WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started? WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status. Additionally, this position will support compliance with all financial reporting requirements and manage the preparation and updating of financial and regulatory reports. Develop forecasts and long-range financial models to support decision-making, rate planning, and financial stewardship. Prepare financial statements, disclosures, and management reports in accordance with established accounting policies and governance. Conduct variance and trend analyses to identify key drivers of performance and recommend actionable improvements. Manage the preparation and filing of external reporting deliverables, including Audited Financial Statements, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) filings, Financial Forecasts, and Internal Revenue Service Form 990. Monitor and evaluate emerging accounting and reporting guidance, assess impacts to financial statements, forecasts, and disclosures, and prepare technical analyses for management review. Develop and maintain budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting procedures to improve efficiency, accuracy, and repeatability. Prepare presentation materials and present financial planning and performance information. Manage audit coordination activities by preparing schedules, analyses, and explanatory materials. Oversee adherence to established internal controls, ensuring control effectiveness through accurate reporting, documentation, and analytical review. Prepare and administer employee performance reviews. Plan for staffing, training and development of department personnel. Coordinate with Chugach departments to support rate cases, compliance filings, and cross-functional financial initiatives. Establish initiatives and manage objectives to Chugach’s overall strategic goals. Prepare and present capital and operating budgets relating to division and contracts. Support continuous improvement and operational efficiency by identifying areas of opportunity and sharing recommendations with management. Other duties as assigned. Relationships Internal Controller: Report to, receive direction, guidance and decisions from. Vice President, Finance & Accounting: Confer with, give and receive information. Managers and Leadership: Confer with, give and receive information Other departments: Coordinate with, provide assistance to and exchange information. External Bargaining Unit Representatives Auditors and Tax Professionals: Coordinate with, provide and exchange information. Consultants: Coordinate with, provide and exchange information. State and Federal Agencies: Exchange information and develop relationships relative to assigned duties. Other Utilities: Coordinate with, provide and exchange information. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med andra nyckelfunktioner inom projektet. I din roll ingår att ha huvudansvar för projektets tidsstyrning och tiduppföljning, inklusive framdrift, prognoser och avvikelsehantering leda, samordna och kvalitetssäkra arbetet med projektets tidsplanering i samverkan med projekttidplanerare och övriga nyckelfunktioner säkerställa att tidplaner upprättas och struktureras enligt projektets gemensamma arbetssätt, WBS och NCC:s processer analysera samband mellan tid, produktion, inköp, projektering, ekonomi och kontraktuella åtaganden identifiera, analysera och rapportera tidsrelaterade risker, möjligheter och konsekvenser för projektets genomförande ta fram tydliga besluts- och prognosunderlag till projektledning, ledningsgrupp och kund i samverkansprojekt bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, verktyg och metoder inom planering, exempelvis genom analyser av kritisk linje, alternativa scenarier och uppföljning av framdrift stödja projektledningen i frågor kopplade till kontraktstid, ändringshantering och tidsrelaterade kommersiella frågeställningar. Din profil som Lead Planner Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att leda och driva planeringsarbete i komplexa miljöer, gärna inom större bygg- och/eller infrastrukturprojekt. Du förstår hur tidplanen påverkar projektets ekonomi, resursplanering, inköp, projektering och produktion. Du har en stark analytisk förmåga och kan omsätta detaljerad information till välgrundade beslut som stödjer verksamhetens övergripande mål. Samtidigt har du förmågan att se helheten, identifiera samband och förutse konsekvenser av olika vägval. Du har god förståelse för produktionsflöden och trivs i en roll där du får skapa struktur, samordna olika intressenter och bidra till att projektet håller rätt riktning genom hela genomförandet. Du har en god förmåga att kommunicera och engagera andra i planeringsarbetet, skapa samsyn mellan olika funktioner samt förmedla komplex information på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift. Erfarenhet av Primavera P6 är meriterande. Om Division Building Stora Projekt Divisionen Building Stora Projekt utvecklar och leder komplexa byggprojekt med ett ordervärde i storleksordningen 1,5 miljarder eller mer. Är du intresserad av andra möjligheter? Vi rekryterar parallellt med denna tjänst följande roller; Projektdirektör, Kommersiell chef, KMA-chef, Produktionschef och Teknisk chef. Läs mer på ncc.se. NCC erbjuder NCC vill vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare med medarbetare som trivs och utvecklas så därför erbjuder vi dig ett stort utbud av personalförmåner och internutbildningar. NCC har kollektivavtal för alla medarbetare vilket ger dig en bra grundtrygghet och ett tydligt regelverk så att du vet vad som gäller för din anställning. Vi erbjuder även försäkringar, arbetstidsförkortning, friskvårdsbidrag samt lunchförmån. Ytterligare erbjudanden och rabatter hittar du via vår förmånsportal Benify. Ytterligare information Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid. Placeringsorten är flexibel utifrån projektets förutsättningar. Tjänsten förutsätter att du har möjlighet att resa i tjänsten. För den här tjänsten genomför vi bakgrundskontroll i enligt med NCC:s säkerhetskultur. Divisionen kan komma att arbeta med säkerhetsklassade projekt varför säkerhetsprövning kan komma att genomföras. Kontakt och ansökan Vill du veta mer om tjänsten vänligen kontakta Tobias Holmqvist, Division chef, tobias.holmqvist@ncc.se. Då annonsen ligger ute delvis över semestern ber vi därför om överseende med att eventuella frågor inte kan besvaras under veckorna 28–32. Sista ansökningsdagen är den 6 september 2026. Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi önskar dig en fin sommar!

Wij weten het allemaal en helpen je om alles uit het gesprek te halen. Het gaat om een functie waarbij je uiteindelijk de vaste kern van het bedrijf gaat versterken. This is a hands-on sales role. You’ll spend time talking directly with business owners and managers, visiting businesses, giving demos, following up with leads, and closing deals. You’ll also work closely with the product team. What you hear from customers matters. Objections, missing features, repeated questions, and reasons businesses buy or don’t buy will help shape sesame. Able to explain technology in simple language. Persistent with follow-ups without being pushy. Organized and comfortable working toward clear sales targets. English is a plus. You’ll Do Well Here If You don’t wait for leads to come to you. You listen before you sell. You follow up. You know your numbers. And when customers keep giving the same objection, you bring that information back to the team. What We Offer The opportunity to sell a working AI product to businesses in a growing market. Direct involvement with the founders and product team. A role where your customer feedback directly influences the product. Clear sales targets and room to take on more responsibility as the sales operation grows. You will be the main point of contact for our clients, keeping them informed of relevant milestones, blockers, or changes that a project needs. It’s not good to over or under-inform, so the project manager must be able to cascade the right information to the relevant people at the appropriate time. You will be in charge of the projects’ schedule, requirements backlog, and to-do lists. Expect to work with both internal and client teams, and sometimes even push back on them, to keep the project on track -- effectively communicating at varying levels of seniority and contexts is a must. You will be expected to systematically break down big, vague requests into smaller, more actionable tasks for our teams. Internally, you will be establishing workflows for your project teams depending on various factors like the nature of the project and the working style of your members. You need to quickly identify and improve on things that don’t work, as well as document and codify the things that do as best practices. The Project Manager is expected to create appropriate protocols, remove blockers, and address risks in a timely fashion, so that your team works at maximum efficiency. You must be able to build a strong rapport with your project teams.
